name: A Seat for the Lord and Lady
summary: Three ghost passengers will only sit in the lounge by rank, and Lord Phillip fears a scene.

stages.journal: Phillip wants the songstress, the daydreamer and the harlequin seated in the lounge without a slight.
stages.hint: Use the banquette in the lounge car; Lady Adela may know the order.

stages.journal: The lounge is seated, quietly or not.
